headline: Ghana Annual Inflation Rises to 11-Month High of 5.5% in October
summary: Ghana's annual inflation rate rose to an 11-month high of 5.5% in October, up from 5.2% in September, driven primarily by rising transport costs.
why: Consumer price inflation figures guide central bank monetary policy decisions and influence domestic bond yields and currency stability.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation creates pressure on purchasing power and monetary policy.
